name: Stormbringer: Tome of Lightning rank 1 works natively (#1678)
contract: Rank-one Tome of Lightning 300606 promises two-percent critical strike chance and twenty-percent interrupt/silence duration reduction. Raw effect zero is a MECHANIC_SILENCE duration modifier resolving to -20, effect one is native MOD_CRIT_PCT resolving to +2, and raw effect two is a MECHANIC_INTERRUPT modifier resolving to -25. AscensionStormbringer::ApplyContracts aligns effect two's base points with the authored silence reduction. Unit::ModSpellDuration reads the recipient's mechanic-duration modifiers both when resolving a negative aura and from Spell::EffectInterruptCast before the real school lockout is applied. This scenario verifies silence using an ordinary hostile Spell Lock debuff 24259 and an untalented control, plus critical chance; stormbringer-tome-of-lightning-interrupt-duration-1678 separately verifies real interrupts after normal Lightning advancement acquisition. The attacker and targets are outside sanctuary with opposing factions. Record 706308 lacks a passive flag and any current acquisition path, so neither scenario claims that record is restored or that the whole report is resolved.
